editorial_review.character_consistency: Milo and June are reused from the library; Glim dim (SC1-9) and STAR variant (SC10-11) only.
editorial_review.story_originality: The dimmest firefly is secretly a baby star; distinct from EP004's bread-star twist (different conflict, emotional rather than comic). The two endings are scheduled far apart in the release order.
editorial_review.scene_continuity: Lanterns lit (SC2) -> out (SC5) -> relit (SC9); storm starts SC5, clears SC9.
editorial_review.visual_quality: Signature frames - firefly wave (SC1), dark lantern (SC2), lone light in the storm (SC8), rising star (SC10).
editorial_review.animation_feasibility: Glow particles reused; dark scenes are cheap to render.
editorial_review.pacing: Rejection by 7.5s, storm at 16.5s, brave choice at 25.5s, rescue 29.5s, twist last 5s.
editorial_review.sound_sync: The music-box motif carries the emotion and survives the storm.
editorial_review.strong_opening: A wave of thousands of fireflies with one failing light.
editorial_review.memorable_ending: The firefly becomes a star and twinkles back.
